goal: Establish a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm for 3-SAT/SAT with proof-carrying correctness and universal coverage. Only after all obligations are proved may SAT_IN_P be elevated.
captain_obviousness_law: CORRECT + FOR_ALL + ALWAYS_TERMINATES + POLYNOMIAL_WORK = SAT_IN_P; SAT_IN_P for an NP-complete SAT formulation implies P=NP.

theorem_target.input_domain: every valid 3-CNF formula F of encoding length n
theorem_target.required_statement: TRUMP(F) returns the correct SAT/UNSAT answer and halts within n^O(1) deterministic operations

O1_CORRECTNESS.statement: Every nonterminal transition is semantics-preserving/equisatisfiable under its declared reconstruction contract, and every terminal result has an independently checkable certificate.

O2_PROGRESS_AND_TERMINATION.statement: There exists a well-founded progress measure Phi such that every accepted nonterminal transition strictly decreases Phi, and the number of accepted transitions from any input of size n is polynomially bounded in n.
O2_PROGRESS_AND_TERMINATION.forbidden_gap: strict descent alone is insufficient if Phi has superpolynomial height or encoding blow-up

O3_POLYNOMIAL_WORK_PER_TRANSITION.statement: Candidate discovery, construction, intermediate representation, certificate generation, independent verification, and state update are all polynomially bounded in the original/current encoding size with no hidden oracle/advice or exponential parameter.
forbidden_debt: factorial signed-map search without a polynomial bound
verification that recomputes an exponential search

O4_UNIVERSAL_COVERAGE.statement: For every reachable nonterminal state F, at least one polynomially discoverable certified transition exists, or a polynomially verifiable terminal certificate exists.
O4_UNIVERSAL_COVERAGE.canonical_form: NONTERMINAL(F) => EXISTS v: DISCOVER_POLY(v,F) AND CERT(F->F_v)=PASS AND (TERMINAL(F_v) OR Phi(F_v)<Phi(F))

O5_GLOBAL_COMPLEXITY_COMPOSITION.statement: The polynomial bound on number of transitions composed with polynomial per-transition work yields one explicit polynomial bound T(n) <= n^k (or equivalent polynomial p(n)) for the full algorithm, including representation growth and reconstruction.

r46_role.R46A_WATCHED_RUP: performance/producer replacement; must not be counted as universal coverage proof
r46_role.R46B_FIRST_CERTIFIED_DESCENT: remove global-best requirement if correctness/progress/resource envelope are local to an accepted transition
r46_role.R46C_JANUS_RANKER: candidate ordering only; LEARNED_GUIDANCE != PROOF_AUTHORITY; exhaustive certified fallback retained
r46_role.R46D_INCREMENTAL_STATE: reuse/update state rather than recompute; must preserve exact semantics and certificate verification

next_universal_gate_after_r46.name: R47A_UNIVERSAL_CERTIFIED_DESCENT_OR_EXPLICIT_COUNTEREXAMPLE
next_universal_gate_after_r46.question: Does every reachable nonterminal TRUMP state admit a polynomially discoverable certified terminal/descent transition under the frozen macro grammar?
next_universal_gate_after_r46.pass_condition: a symbolic universal proof with explicit polynomial discovery and representation bounds
next_universal_gate_after_r46.fail_or_open_condition: an explicit reachable counterexample/stall, an unbounded parameter, or an unresolved universal proof obligation
next_universal_gate_after_r46.finite_sampling_role: counterexample hunting and regression only; never theorem elevation
